scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.package: pnpm clean && pnpm test && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => { for (const d of ['dist', '.test-build']) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.test: pnpm run check && pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".test-build/test/**/*.test.js"
